oresense.tooltip.empty.more.1: Use to open the menu and add a sample:
oresense.tooltip.empty.more.2: an ore block, its drops, or something made from them.
oresense.tooltip.usage.lock: Locks onto a vein; mining it spends amethyst.
oresense.msg.no_sample: The sensor has no sample to look for.
oresense.msg.not_an_ore: %s does not come from any ore the sensor knows.
oresense.tooltip.needs_shards: Needs %s shard(s) to lock the vein it found.
oresense.msg.pick.fallback: Too many matching blocks around to compare veins; the sensor points at the closest one instead.
oresense.settings.title: OreSense Settings
oresense.settings.display.skin.desc: Which dial art to draw. Resource packs can still retexture any skin.
Needle glow, sonar sweep and gauge pulse. Off holds them steady. The needle still turns.
oresense.settings.scanning.horizontalRan: How far out the sensor looks, in blocks. Larger boxes cost the server more per scan.
oresense.settings.scanning.verticalRange: How far up and down it looks, in blocks.
oresense.settings.scanning.scanIntervalT: Ticks between scans of a held sensor. 20 is once a second.
oresense.settings.scanning.showDirection: Adds a compass direction, and above or below, to the text reading. Needs Text reading.
oresense.settings.scanning.showActionBar: Also print the reading above the hotbar. The needle shows it either way.
oresense.settings.scanning.oresOnly.desc: Samples must be ores, what they drop, or what is made from that. Off: any block.
oresense.settings.charging.chargeMode.de: One price per vein, paid at its first block. Shards per vein sets the price.
Bigger veins cost more: a shard per Blocks per shard blocks, paid at the first block.
One shard for every block you mine. The lock is never paid off.
oresense.settings.charging.shardsPerVein: Per vein price. 0 makes the sensor free.
oresense.settings.charging.blocksPerShar: Per size price: one shard per this many blocks of the vein, rounded up.
oresense.settings.charging.veinCap.desc: Most blocks one lock covers. A geode shell is over 64.
oresense.settings.charging.lockGraceTick: How long, in ticks, a lock survives out of range before it is let go.
oresense.settings.targeting.targetPick.d: Closest: the nearest vein. Largest: the biggest vein in range, the nearer one on a tie.
